bb-riverboats: Office hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m., year-round. From May through September, the office operates seven days a week until 7 p.m.; the FAQ also says it opens whenever a public cruise sails. These are office hours, not a sailing timetable.
BB Riverboats offices are open Monday through Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. year-round.
During the regular cruise season from May through September, office hours extend to 7:00 p.m. and operate seven days a week.
Whenever a public cruise is sailing, our office will be open to assist guests.

The FAQ allows reservation transfers with at least 48 hours’ notice; a difference in cruise value is issued as a gift certificate. It says monetary refunds require Ticket Assurance, which costs 10% of the pre-tax ticket price, must be bought when reserving and permits a refund of the ticket price up to departure. Confirm the policy for your booking type before reserving.

Reservations may be transferred to a new cruise date or experience with at least 48 hours’ notice prior to departure. Any difference in cruise value will be issued as a gift certificate. Monetary refunds are only available when Ticket Assurance is purchased at the time of booking.

Ticket Assurance allows guests to receive a full refund of the ticket price up until cruise departure for any reason. Ticket Assurance costs 10% of the pre-tax ticket price and must be purchased at the time of reservation. It cannot be added after the reservation has been finalized.

The dining-cruise page describes live music and entertainment and includes live entertainment with dining tickets. It does not specify sound levels, assistive-listening equipment or a quiet seating area; discuss those needs for the particular sailing.
guests can relax, dine, enjoy live music and entertainment
All dining cruise tickets include your meal, live entertainment, and breathtaking views of the Ohio River.
